evidence.label: Core HICP YoY
evidence.note: Core HICP remains above a target-consistent comfort zone, limiting the case for aggressive easing.

evidence.note: Unemployment is close to its recent low, so labor weakness adds little easing pressure.

evidence.note: Growth is below the weak-growth threshold, adding clear easing pressure.

evidence.note: Peripheral sovereign spreads are contained and do not signal acute Eurozone financial stress.

evidence.note: EUR/USD YoY Change is not adding meaningful tightening pressure.

transmissions.label: Yen carry → US risk assets
transmissions.mechanism: JPY funding conditions and Japanese yields can alter leveraged global risk appetite.
transmissions.summary: Current classification uses only cached JPY/JGB and US financial-condition evidence.
transmissions.caveat: A transmission channel is not proof that it caused an observed market move.

transmissions.label: US rates → USD/JPY → BOJ pressure
transmissions.mechanism: US/Japan rate conditions transmit through USD/JPY and imported inflation pressure.
transmissions.summary: The Compass explicitly models US rates, USD/JPY and BOJ normalization pressure.
transmissions.caveat: Direction is model context, not a forecast of the exchange rate.

transmissions.label: Fed/ECB divergence → EUR/USD
transmissions.mechanism: Relative policy and growth conditions can transmit through EUR/USD and regional financial conditions.
transmissions.summary: Both policy frameworks are integrated; several Euro Area financial subcomponents remain missing.
transmissions.caveat: The Euro Area is a monetary union; this does not represent every EU member's fiscal conditions.

transmissions.label: US rates/USD → KRW and KOSPI
transmissions.mechanism: Dollar and funding conditions can affect USD/KRW, foreign flows and export-sensitive Korean equities.
transmissions.summary: The KOSPI monitor defines the channel, but its current sweep and foreign-flow data are not persisted.
transmissions.caveat: Structural plausibility is not an active-signal claim and Granger tests are not causal proof.

transmissions.label: USD conditions → SGD policy pressure
transmissions.mechanism: Global dollar conditions and trade-weighted FX pressure interact with Singapore's exchange-rate policy framework.
transmissions.summary: A current official or shadow-NEER band position is unavailable.
transmissions.caveat: The S$NEER basket, centre, slope and width are explicit proxy assumptions.
